canonicalRules.definition: Authoritative evidence is preserved; every derived state remains reconstructable from evidence, rule versions, effective time, security context, and lineage.

An Agent may retrieve, expose, transform, propose, stage, or commit only within the intersection of the interacting principal's current authority, the Agent Boundary, applicable policy, and the requested action's required authority.
A Query Rod Hash is a deterministic content-addressed retrieval and verification key for a persisted Compressed Query Rod and its governed contribution lineage.
Revenue, Customer, Member, and other projections may share a canonical identity while remaining intentionally non-equivalent; their divergence is preserved and measured.
Source authority is evaluated by semantic domain; contradictory evidence is preserved and no universal source-priority list is permitted.
Proposal, validation, staging, commit, rejection, and supersession are distinct replayable events retaining effective and recorded time without overwriting evidence.
Magnetic Fields govern semantic attraction and repulsion into compositions; Gravitational Fields govern projection toward Channel Rod temporal-destination coordinates.
Commercial compositions and accounting projections are linked but independently derived; reciprocal inference compares them while preserving journal and upstream causality.
Every governed renderable object resolves canonical identity and visual semantics through versioned shared registries; the production Visual Registry also generates the Dynamic Legend.
Every spatial scene provides a synchronized keyboard-accessible, screen-reader-readable 2D representation and reduced-motion behavior that preserves semantic explanation.

canonicalRules.canonicalName: Member Organization Admin is not a separate identity
canonicalRules.definition: Member Organization Admin capability is created through Organization-scoped authority, module access, view access, Agent access, and action permissions layered onto a canonical Member identity, never a separate user-record type. Implemented by extending data_entitlements.scope; authorityProfileIds/moduleAccessProfileIds/viewAccessProfileIds as separate tables are rejected in favor of this lower-risk mechanism unless a concrete module later needs gating the JSONB shape can't express.

canonicalRules.canonicalName: Member financial data privacy by default
canonicalRules.definition: Personal financial data is Member-private by default and never becomes Organization-visible through inference from Organization Admin authority — only through an explicit authorized sharing action.

A new concept must be checked against the existing substrate before any new table is proposed, in order: new rod_type, new TRIBUTARY_TYPES entry, new journey_rod_events event_type (event-sourced state), new tracked interaction in provisioningPolicyRegistry.js (Orbit/usage), new Atom/Molecule/bonding-rule definition, additive column. A new table is justified only when all six are a genuine poor fit for a structurally different shape. Enforced by the salt-basin-channel-journey-architecture skill.

A governed Molecule instance evolves and matures in place — same identity, updated state, reconstructable from the event log — and is never duplicated on recomputation. Persisting a static, pre-declared list of member Atoms per Molecule/Cluster (as an earlier session mistakenly did for Career Molecules) is a violation of this rule, not an acceptable simplification.

foundationElements.definition: Governed semantic containment environment that may project distributed sources.

Governed interaction, ingress, handoff, integration, projection, or output boundary. Refined 2026-07-29 by Salt_Basin_HOS_Canonical_Ontology_and_MRS_Workbook_v1.xlsx's SOURCE_SYSTEM entity (10_Source_Lineage): a self-referencing Vendor → Product → Module → Instance → Environment → Object → Attribute → Interface hierarchy, each node carrying a Native_Security_Domain and Connection_Mode_Set (API/database/file/event/zero-copy/agent/manual). SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING (canonical object ↔ source attribute, with Authority_Rank, Acquisition_Mode, Persistence_Policy, Write_Back_Policy, Conflict_Policy) and VALUE_PROVENANCE (instance-level origin/derivation/evidence/lineage per Atom Instance) are the column-level mechanism this document's existing Distributed Source Standard (SB-14, docs/canon) already specified at a policy level — same concept, now with a real schema to build against.
Configurable stable category of business meaning used by Atoms.

Smallest independently governed bounded assertion with evidence and temporal lineage. Refined 2026-07-29: the MRS ontology workbook splits this into ELEMENT (context-free primitive, e.g. 'Person First Name' — Element_Family/Semantic_Dimension/Element_Class/Primitive_Storage_Type/etc., already-real concept, minimal change) and ATOM_DEFINITION (the *contextual* semantic role that references exactly one Element — Atom_Code/Contextual_Definition/Semantic_Role_Type identifier|amount|state|evidence|metric-input|join-key|display-value|AI-context/Derivation_Mode entered|copied|referenced|derived|generated|inferred|calculated/Journey_Influence_Type). This registry's existing 'Element' concept already matches the context-free half; 'Atom' matches the contextual half — no conflict, this workbook just gives the Atom side real columns to build against (server/lib/eidosBonding.js and journey_metadata_molecules are the existing implementation surface).
Configurable contextual attraction and repulsion rules governing semantic convergence.

A governed semantic relationship among Atom roles — BOND_DEFINITION (Bond_Type: association/composition/attribution/ownership/denomination/dependency/lineage/evidence/transition/allocation; Directionality: directed/bidirectional/symmetric/ordered-multi-endpoint; Formation_Rule/Dissolution_Rule via BOND_RULE) with BOND_ENDPOINT records for each participating Atom Definition (role, sequence, min/max cardinality), and BOND_INSTANCE at runtime (Source_Instance_ID → Target_Instance_ID). This is the precise, column-level formalization of what this registry already calls Magnetic Field / Semantic Affinity Field and what code already calls 'bonding rules' (per the 2026-07-27 terminology correction, matching server/lib/eidosBonding.js and server/lib/careerBondingEngine.js's tag-overlap affinity matching) — same real mechanism, now with a formal entity/rule-type vocabulary (association vs. composition vs. attribution etc.) the existing bonding engines don't yet distinguish. Per 05_Semantic_Dictionary of Salt_Basin_HOS_Canonical_Ontology_and_MRS_Workbook_v1.xlsx.

AGENT (self-referencing Parent_Agent_ID, Agent_Type: Executive Data Staff | Domain | Journey | Molecule | Atom | Element | Source Governance | Security | User Proxy | Lineage), each carrying its own Permitted_Source_Set, Permitted_Transformation_Set, Memory_Retention_Policy, Exposure_Policy, and Action_Permission_Set; AGENT_ASSIGNMENT binds an Agent to a governed object (Element/Atom/Bond/Molecule/MRS/Highway/Channel/Stream/Current/Gate/Journey/Projection/Source) with a role (primary/validator/approver/observer/lineage/security/source). Per 09_Rules_Agents_Security. **This is real, column-level design for the multi-tier Context Orchestrator → Domain Agents → Source Agents hierarchy Loop 8 (Context) flagged as 'not built... sequencing dependency' on 2026-07-12** — BestyStaff today is a single flat agent with no parent/child structure. Does not build this — flagging so Loop 8's next real pass builds against this schema instead of inventing its own.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: structures (Agent Hierarchy is the governed parent/child structure Channel Rod Staff members are instantiated within)

foundationElements.definition: Channel Rod destination-projection influence over Semantic Compositions.
Governed composition of Atom roles defining meaningful business state.

The complete navigable network through which monetary value, rights, obligations, and evidence flow — contains Highways (MRS_HIGHWAY, 1:N). Per 01_Entity_Catalog/06_MRS_Network_Dictionary of Salt_Basin_HOS_Canonical_Ontology_and_MRS_Workbook_v1.xlsx (Betsy-supplied, 2026-07-29), which resolves the Highway naming question below and is now the canonical, column-level source for the Network and Runtime Journey layers, refining Salt_Basin_Expanded_Semantic_Scenario_and_Business_Instance_Model_v0.2.xlsx's same-day but less formal pass.

Canonical end-to-end value pathway, contained by an MRS and containing Channels (HIGHWAY_CHANNEL, 1:N — a Channel may participate in more than one Highway if governed). Carries a Value_Flow_Type (commercial, capital, revenue, cash, debt, asset, service, operational, risk, evidence, etc.) and optional canonical start/end Stage. Per Betsy 2026-07-29: "Highway is the end to end process flow governance (was previously defined as the channel rod)" — the real, live, governing role earlier loosely attributed to Channel Rod is now formally Highway's. This does NOT change Channel Rod's own 2026-07-16 definition (still the persistent instance of one Channel) — Highway sits one level above Channel as the cross-Channel domain governor.
foundationElements.resolutionNote: NAMING COLLISION RESOLVED 2026-07-29: 06_MRS_Network_Dictionary's own sheet description is literally 'the Salt Basin Network Monetary River System, Highways, Channels, Streams, Currents, Stages, Gates, and Tributaries' — this IS the formalization SB-25-ROADMAP-DEPENDENCY-READINESS.md's 'Salt Basin Highways™' entry named as architecture-only/nothing-built (Route Intelligence Engine, Eligibility Engine, Monetary River System, etc.). Not a collision between two unrelated meanings — the trademark and this architecture object are the same concept, now getting real schema. SB-25 should be updated to reflect this the next time Loop 1/Loop 25-equivalent work touches it (not done in this pass — SB-25 lives under docs/canon/, out of this registry's direct scope).

foundationElements.definition: The definition of a temporal-destination corridor type — a governed process route within a Highway — governing what kind of semantic state can be projected, positioned, diverted, recombined, settled, and interpreted along corridors of that type (e.g. Member, Customer, Revenue Lifecycle, Fund Deal, Portfolio Company, Value Creation). Declared once per type; carries no live state itself. Backed by journey_rod_types (server/db.js). Carries an optional Commercial_Motion_Type (direct sales, partner sales, capital formation, acquisition, asset management, exit, etc.), a Primary_Subject_Molecule_Definition_ID, and default Entry/Exit Gates.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: definition-of (Channel Rod / Channel Journey is the persistent instance of a Channel)

foundationElements.definition: The persistent instance of a Channel definition: one real, live occurrence of that Channel type for a specific entity, carrying actual temporal state, evidence, and settlement. Every journey_data_rods row is a Channel Rod instantiating its rod_type's Channel definition. Confirmed 2026-07-29 as the same concept the MRS ontology calls Channel Journey (CHANNEL_JOURNEY: 'actual traversal of a Channel by a primary Molecule Instance') — matches the already-decided 2026-07-27 terminology that a Channel instance is a Channel Journey; no conflict, just two names for the same real object across two sessions' documents.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: instance-of (Channel is the definition this Channel Rod instantiates)

foundationElements.definition: A scenario-specific configured pathway within a Channel (business model, segment, product, geography, transaction, or variant context), gated by an Activation_Rule. A Channel has many Streams (CHANNEL_STREAM, 1:N); reusable Stream templates may associate to multiple Channels. A Stream contains many Currents (1:N).
foundationElements.resolutionNote: STREAM/CURRENT PLACEMENT RESOLVED 2026-07-29 by 07_Journey_Dictionary's JOURNEY_POSITION entity: Highway_ID and Channel_ID are Required=Yes, but Stream_ID and Current_ID are both Required=No (nullable). Stream is therefore an OPTIONAL scenario-specific refinement, not a mandatory layer every Channel Journey passes through — a journey's position is fully valid with just Highway+Channel(+Stage); Stream only applies when the journey is inside a scenario-specific configured pathway (matches OBJ-003's own examples: Amendment Configuration Stream, Renewal Configuration Stream — variant paths, not the universal default).

foundationElements.definition: A defined state or position in a Channel pathway — Stage_Level gives hierarchy depth, Parent_Stage_ID supports sub-stages, Completion_Definition states the semantic conditions for completion. A Highway may declare a canonical start/end Stage. Per 06_MRS_Network_Dictionary. NEW 2026-07-29, not yet cross-referenced against this registry's existing concept-current, whose 2026-07-27 definition ('port stage', 'port stage maturity') already uses 'stage' informally as part of the rule-set it defines — needs reconciliation, not assumed identical.

An entry, exit, approval, validation, security, evidence, financial, contractual, or temporal control, evaluated via an Evaluation_Rule (Context_Rule). A Channel may declare default Entry/Exit Gates. Per 06_MRS_Network_Dictionary. NEW 2026-07-29 — maps onto what the existing 'Convergence / Gate' vocabulary in Salt_Basin_Expanded_Semantic_Scenario_and_Business_Instance_Model_v0.2.xlsx's Scenario_Catalog already used informally (e.g. SCN-001's 'Purpose-specific completeness threshold met'); this is that concept formalized as a first-class entity.
Policy-bounded agent workforce built from the reusable BestyStaff template architecture.
Governed bridge that normalizes, translates, reconciles, simulates, validates, and maps distributed evidence into the semantic model.
Canonical identity for every interacting user; Organization membership, roles, and Organization Admin authority attach to it rather than creating a duplicate identity.

Client scope owning Channels and Tributaries — a Member (no Organization profiles assigned) or a Member Organization. Not a stored row: resolved as the set of journey_data_rods sharing a user_id (member scope) or org_id (organization scope). Atoms/Molecules are shared, never duplicated, across every Channel instance, Tributary, and sub-journey within a Riverbed.

The rule set defining a Channel journey's context: entry criteria, derived-data rules, per-state user input, maturity progression entry/exit, minimum carry, required context data, port stage, port stage maturity. Exists in a master-data (canonical) or Channel-current (journey-instance) scope, without duplicating the underlying Atoms/Molecules.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: rules-for (Current Arc is the resulting state a Current's rules produce)
foundationElements.openFollowUp: NEW 2026-07-29, NOT auto-resolved — do not silently merge: 06_MRS_Network_Dictionary defines CURRENT as 'a directed executable movement SEGMENT within or between Streams' (an edge with From_Stage_ID/To_Stage_ID, Current_Type enum standard/conditional/return/escalation/merge/split/cross-channel/cross-highway, Capacity_Value, strength/momentum method) — structurally an edge between two Stages, not a rule set. This registry's existing Current (decided 2026-07-27) is the rule set governing entry/exit/maturity progression, closer to what the new workbook calls a Gate's Evaluation_Rule or a Stage's Completion_Definition than to its own Current. Needs an explicit Betsy decision before either definition is built against: is 'Current' the rule (2026-07-27 sense) or the movement segment/edge (2026-07-29 sense)? Flagging per the 'never silently reinterpret a Betsy-defined term' rule — this is exactly that case, not a rename to make unilaterally.

foundationElements.definition: The actual temporal data state produced by evaluating a Current's rules against shared Atoms/Molecules across journey Channels — distinct from the Current (rules) itself. Event-sourced as journey_rod_events rows, reconstructed by reading a Rod's events in order.

Persisted, definable branchable-relationship structure defined by a Highway, Channel, or Stream and invoked (never owned) by a Current — branch type, entry points, gates, and convergence rules. The definition side of the same definition/instance split already established for Channel/Channel Rod. Refined 2026-07-29 by 06_MRS_Network_Dictionary's TRIBUTARY_CONNECTION entity (a governed connection From_Current_ID → To_Current_ID, across Streams/Channels/Highways, with a Connection_Type enum — branch/merge/transfer/escalation/return/cross-channel/cross-highway — and a Context_Transfer_Policy governing what values/evidence/security/lineage transfer): TRIBUTARY_CONNECTION is the network-topology DEFINITION layer for this concept; treat it as the more precise successor name for what OBJ-005 called Nested Tributary, kept as an alias rather than a second concept.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: definition-of (Tributary Branch / Journey Branch is the persistent instance of a Nested Tributary / Tributary Connection)

foundationElements.definition: Persisted runtime relationship connecting Journeys, Channels, Streams, Molecules, dependencies, and locks — coordination authority, locks, participant references, confluence history. Created or joined by a Nested Tributary/Tributary Connection invocation; persists after confluence so historical/relational context remains available. This is the concept the pre-existing Loop 14 (Collaboration) presence work (checkpoint_presence, collaborationRegistry.js) is real infrastructure for, though it wasn't named this precisely at build time. NOT the same entity as the newly-added Journey Branch below — Tributary Branch is the N:M coordination-context view (many journeys/channels connected together); Journey Branch is the 1:1 lineage-fork view (one journey forking into one child journey). Both real, both needed, do not collapse into one.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: instance-of (Nested Tributary/Tributary Connection is the definition this Tributary Branch instantiates)

foundationElements.definition: Bitemporal historical, current, planned, projected, simulated, or alternative location of a Channel Journey within the network — references MRS/Highway/Channel (required) and Stream/Current/Stage (optional), plus Entry_At/Exit_At/Recorded_At and a Confidence_Score for projected/inferred positions. This is the precise mechanism this registry's Current Arc concept already gestures at (event-sourced state per journey) but had not specified down to the column level.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: positions (a Channel Rod/Channel Journey has 1..* Journey Positions)

foundationElements.definition: A governed branch from a parent Channel Journey to a new child Channel Journey, with a Branch_Reason_Code and a Merge_Status (open/merged/terminated/historical lineage). The 1:1 lineage-fork view of branching — distinct from Tributary Branch's N:M coordination-context view (see above). Per 07_Journey_Dictionary.
foundationElements.relationshipToRelated: forks (a Channel Rod/Channel Journey may have a Parent_Journey_ID and spawn child journeys via Journey Branch)

foundationElements.definition: Per-module user interface, callable API, and usage-tracking surface (logins, queries, projection versions) per module per Member profile. Formalizes the pre-existing 3D orbit visual metaphor into a real tracked object. Implemented via usageTracking.js/analytics_events/provisioningPolicyRegistry.js's tracked-interaction registry, not new infrastructure.
